title: Multisubject, multimodal face processing
description: A multi-subject, multi-modal neuroimaging dataset on face processing, combining structural MRI, functional MRI, MEG and EEG from the same participants. Participants viewed famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces, with initial, immediate-repeat and delayed-repeat presentations. This BIDS release is a 16-subject subset of the original 19-subject study, intended for multimodal integration and methods development.
methods_description: Participants performed a face recognition task with famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces. Data were acquired with simultaneous MEG and EEG, with three anatomical fiducials digitized for MEG-MRI alignment. Structural MPRAGE T1 images (defaced) and functional MRI runs were also collected. MRIQC quality control outputs are included.
